title: 离心机的正确使用（国内版）
source_doc: course/General Lab Safety Practices/05_How to Use a Centrifuge.md
author_source: project/General Lab Safety Practices/05_How to Use a Centrifuge（国内版）/src.py

points.S2: 个人防护与样品管检查
points.S3: 运行前检查转子和腔体

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有一台小型台式离心机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a small white benchtop centrifuge, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲离心机的正确使用。

shots.scene: 管子、天平、转子盖、旋钮四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a small plastic tube, a balance scale, a round rotor lid, and a control knob. No people.
shots.narration: 管子、配平、盖子、设置，一个都不能错。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一支样品管走向离心机，神情轻松
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks toward a benchtop centrifuge holding a single small sample tube, looking relaxed.
shots.narration: 阿杰只有一管样品，想马上离心。

shots.scene: 转子上只放一支管、另一侧空着的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A top view icon of a centrifuge rotor holding only one tube with all other slots empty, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 他把管子一插，就要按启动键。

shots.scene: 小研伸手拦住阿杰，指着离心机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops the young male student and points at the open centrifuge.
shots.narration: 小研说：慢着，没配平可不行！

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods encouragingly.
shots.narration: 离心机转得飞快，每一步都要做对。

shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍一台小型台式离心机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the lid of a small white benchtop microcentrifuge on a lab bench.
shots.narration: 实验室里，离心机有好几种。

shots.scene: 小型台式微量离心机，开盖可见小转子
shots.prompt_en: A small benchtop microcentrifuge with its lid open, showing a compact round rotor with many small slots. No people.
shots.narration: 台式微量离心机，用来甩小离心管。

shots.scene: 一台较大的台式离心机，旁边有雪花温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A larger benchtop centrifuge with a blank control panel, and a snowflake thermometer icon floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 带温控的台式离心机，能放更大的管子。

shots.scene: 落地式高速离心机，机身厚重
shots.prompt_en: A heavy floor-standing high-speed centrifuge with a round lid and a blank control panel, standing in a lab corner. No people.
shots.narration: 落地式高速离心机，转速更高。

shots.scene: 洗衣机图标被打叉，旁边是离心机
shots.prompt_en: A washing machine icon crossed out with a red X, next to a floor-standing centrifuge with a caution triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它可不是洗衣机，不能随便摆弄。

shots.scene: 三台离心机排成一排，上方浮现清单
shots.prompt_en: Three centrifuges of different sizes stand in a row; a blank checklist card with four empty boxes floats above them. No people.
shots.narration: 不管用哪一台，都要记住四件事。

shots.scene: 小研举起一支小离心管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat and nitrile gloves, holds up a small clear plastic microtube.
shots.narration: 第一件事：离心管要和离心机配套。

shots.scene: 小管稳稳插进转子孔位，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A clear microtube slides snugly into a matching slot of a benchtop rotor, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的1.5毫升管，适合多数台式机。

shots.scene: 不同大小的管子对着不同大小的孔位
shots.prompt_en: Tubes of several sizes, each paired by an arrow to a slot of matching size. No people.
shots.narration: 管子太大放不进，太小会晃动。

shots.scene: 小研两手各拿一支管，一大一小
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a small tube in one hand and a larger microtube in the other, comparing their sizes.
shots.narration: 0.5毫升的小管也能用这台离心机。

shots.scene: 小管套进深色适配器，再放进孔位
shots.prompt_en: A tiny tube is placed into a dark plastic adapter sleeve, and the sleeve is then set into a rotor slot. No people.
shots.narration: 但要先套进适配器，再放进孔位。

shots.scene: 小管直接掉进大孔、管身开裂的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny tube dropped loose into an oversized slot with a crack on it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用适配器，管子可能被甩破。

shots.scene: 小研双手各举一支离心管对比
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up two clear microtubes side by side at eye level.
shots.narration: 第二件事：离心管必须配平。

shots.scene: 两支管液面一高一低，红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two clear tubes side by side, one filled much higher than the other, with a red X between them. No people.
shots.narration: 一管多一管少，就是不平衡。

shots.scene: 两支管液面一样高，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Two clear tubes side by side filled to exactly the same level, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 两管装到同样的量，才算平衡。

shots.scene: 小研用移液器向一支管中补液，与另一支对齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a pipette to add liquid into one tube until it matches the level of the other tube.
shots.narration: 补到同样体积，液面对齐。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两支同样高的小管
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two small tubes filled to the same level.
shots.narration: 同种溶液的小管，看体积一致即可。

shots.scene: 转子俯视图，两支管放在正对的孔位
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a round rotor with numbered-dot slots; two tubes sit in slots exactly opposite each other across the center. No people.
shots.narration: 两支管要放在转子正对的位置。

shots.scene: 两支管放在相邻孔位的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon with two tubes placed in neighboring slots on the same side, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 挨着放在同一边，转起来会失衡。

shots.scene: 阿杰手里只有一支样品管，挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a single sample tube and scratches his head beside the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 只有一个样品怎么办？

shots.scene: 小研往一支空管中加入等量的水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pipettes water into an empty tube to match the volume of the sample tube held by the young male student.
shots.narration: 另取一管，装入等体积的水来配平。

shots.scene: 样品管和配平管放在正对孔位
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a rotor with the sample tube and the matching balance tube in exactly opposite slots. No people.
shots.narration: 配平管放在样品管的正对面。

shots.scene: 小研把透明转子盖放到转子中心
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a clear round rotor lid onto the center of the rotor inside an open benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 第三件事：盖上转子盖并拧紧。

shots.scene: 手拧转子盖中心的旋钮，旁边绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand turns the center knob of the rotor lid until it is firmly fixed, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认盖子固定牢靠。

shots.scene: 小研合上离心机外盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the outer lid of the benchtop centrifuge until it clicks shut.
shots.narration: 然后再关上离心机的外盖。

shots.scene: 转子盖松动飞出的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a loose rotor lid lifting off a spinning rotor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 转子盖没拧紧，高速下会松脱。

shots.scene: 离心机控制面板，两个旋钮，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a centrifuge control panel with two round knobs and a blank display screen. No people.
shots.narration: 第四件事：开机前检查设置。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白实验方案转动旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns a knob on the centrifuge panel while checking a blank protocol sheet.
shots.narration: 时间和转速，都按实验方案来设。

shots.scene: 转速表指针停在红区之前，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A speed gauge icon with its needle stopping just before the red zone, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 转速最关键，不能让管子承受不住。

shots.scene: 离心管和转子上各有一个上限图标
shots.prompt_en: A microtube and a rotor, each with a small maximum limit icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 看清管子和转子允许的最高转速。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四个打勾的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating icons with green check marks: a tube, a balance scale, a rotor lid and a knob.
shots.narration: 选对管、配好平、拧紧盖、查设置。

shots.scene: 失衡离心机剧烈震动、在台面上移动的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unbalanced centrifuge shaking violently with motion lines and sliding across a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 做不到，离心机会剧烈震动。

shots.scene: 破碎的管子和损坏的转子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cracked tube and a damaged rotor with warning triangle icons. No people.
shots.narration: 严重时破管、损坏转子，甚至伤人。

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰和小研讲解离心机
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a benchtop centrifuge to the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 第一次用离心机，先培训，看操作规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白使用登记本上填写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes in a blank equipment log book placed beside the centrifuge.
shots.narration: 公用离心机，用前用后都要登记。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与样品管检查
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at the bench wearing a buttoned lab coat, nitrile gloves and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 操作样品时，穿好实验服，戴上手套。
overlay: 个人防护与样品管检查

shots.section_title: 个人防护与样品管检查
shots.scene: 小研对着光检查离心管有没有裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a microtube up to the light and checks it carefully for cracks.
shots.narration: 离心管先查有没有裂纹和变形。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与样品管检查
shots.scene: 装得太满的管子被打叉，适量的管子打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two tubes side by side: an overfilled tube crossed out with a red X and a properly filled tube with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不要装太满，不超过管子的最大装量。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与样品管检查
shots.scene: 手按下管盖，咔哒盖紧
shots.prompt_en: A gloved thumb presses a microtube cap down until it snaps tightly shut. No people.
shots.narration: 管盖要盖紧，防止甩出漏液。

shots.section_title: 运行前检查转子和腔体
shots.scene: 小研打开离心机盖往腔内看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the centrifuge lid and looks inside the chamber.
shots.narration: 放样前，先看腔体和转子。
overlay: 运行前检查转子和腔体

shots.section_title: 运行前检查转子和腔体
shots.scene: 干净干燥的离心腔，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean and dry centrifuge chamber with the rotor sitting level on its shaft, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 腔内干净干燥，转子装稳到位。

shots.section_title: 运行前检查转子和腔体
shots.scene: 转子与离心管型号匹配的图标
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon and a tube icon joined by a green link symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 转子要和离心机、离心管配套。

shots.section_title: 运行前检查转子和腔体
shots.scene: 有裂纹的转子图标被打叉，旁边是报告图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a rotor with a visible crack crossed out with a red X, next to a speech bubble report icon. No people.
shots.narration: 转子有裂纹、腐蚀，停用并报告。

shots.scene: 转子上三支管等距分布
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a rotor with three tubes placed at equal spacing around the circle, like a triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 管子多时，按转子等分位置对称摆放。

shots.scene: 小研在天平上称两支大离心管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs two large centrifuge tubes one after another on a lab balance with a blank display.
shots.narration: 大体积或溶液轻重不同，要用天平称。

shots.scene: 两只吊篮挂在转子两侧，成对对称
shots.prompt_en: A swinging bucket rotor icon with two buckets hanging on exactly opposite sides, both holding tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 吊篮、适配器也要成对对称放置。

shots.scene: 配平管装同样的缓冲液
shots.prompt_en: Two tubes side by side holding the same kind of clear liquid, linked by an equal sign icon. No people.
shots.narration: 配平液尽量和样品溶液一样。

shots.scene: 小研确认外盖关好后按下启动键
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks that the centrifuge lid is closed, then presses the start button on a blank panel.
shots.narration: 外盖关好，再按启动键。

shots.scene: 小研站在离心机旁注视
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands beside the running centrifuge and watches it attentively.
shots.narration: 启动后先别走，等升到设定转速。

shots.scene: 离心机剧烈抖动，手按停止键
shots.prompt_en: A benchtop centrifuge shaking with motion lines; a hand presses the stop button on the blank panel.
shots.narration: 有异响或剧烈震动，立即按停止键。

shots.scene: 趴在离心机上、在上面放东西的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person leaning on a running centrifuge and of bottles placed on its lid, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 运行时不倚靠、不在机盖上放东西。

shots.scene: 转子图标逐渐减速，最后停住
shots.prompt_en: A rotor icon with fading motion lines slowing down and finally coming to a complete stop. No people.
shots.narration: 离心结束，等转子完全停稳。

shots.scene: 用手按住转子和强行掀盖的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hand stopping a spinning rotor and of a hand forcing open a locked lid, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用手刹转子，不强行开盖。

shots.scene: 小研打开外盖，再慢慢拧开转子盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the centrifuge lid, then slowly unscrews the rotor lid.
shots.narration: 盖子解锁后再打开，慢慢拧开转子盖。

shots.scene: 小研轻轻取出管子，看有无漏液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently lifts the tubes out and checks them and the rotor for leaks.
shots.narration: 轻拿样品管，看看有无破管漏液。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志旁是一个密封转子
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard warning sign next to a sealed rotor icon. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性样品，按生物安全规定操作。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾擦干腔体，盖子开着晾干
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the inside of the centrifuge chamber dry with a paper towel and leaves the lid open.
shots.narration: 用完擦干腔体，开盖晾干。

shots.scene: 阿杰关闭电源，在登记本上记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the centrifuge and writes in the blank equipment log book.
shots.narration: 关机、登记，样品带走。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，旁边离心机贴着空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man; a centrifuge nearby has a blank out-of-service tag on it.
shots.narration: 破管、故障，停用并报告负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现离心管和适配器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of microtubes and an adapter sleeve.
shots.narration: 管子配套，小管用适配器。

shots.scene: 两支等量的管子对称放在转子上
shots.prompt_en: Two equally filled tubes sit in opposite slots of a rotor. No people.
shots.narration: 体积一致，对称放置。

shots.scene: 转子盖拧紧、转速表指针在安全区
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tightened rotor lid and a speed gauge needle in the safe zone. No people.
shots.narration: 拧紧盖子，转速不超上限。

shots.scene: 停稳的转子与登记本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stopped rotor, a pair of gloves and a blank log book. No people.
shots.narration: 停稳再开盖，用后整理登记。

shots.scene: 欣欣在离心机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy benchtop centrifuge.
shots.narration: 转得稳，才用得安全，下次见！
